name: 120 Atlantic Ave, two weeks (Mon 2026-09-21 to Fri 2026-10-02)
about: Two linked groups (Site, MEP) and the filed daily reports. 12 questions: 10 with cited answers (incl. a relayed decision -- the poster is not the decider -- and a plan that must stay a plan), 2 the records cannot answer.

messages.text: Morning all. Week plan: underpinning pits 1-4 Tuesday/Wednesday, storefront shop drawings due Friday, MEP rough-in 2nd floor starts next week.
@Sam can you get us the storefront shop drawings by Friday?
Yes, storefront shop drawings Friday
Excavation for pits 1 and 2 done, waiting on special inspector before we pour
who has the gang box key?
Luis has it
Riser shop drawings will be ready next Monday
Special inspector signed off pits 1-4, we pour tomorrow 7am
Underpinning pits 1–4 poured this morning, 12 yards, 4000 psi mix
Great, thanks Dave
Temp power panel moved to the east wall, Con Ed inspection Friday
Owner wants the 3B bedroom window changed to a casement, not the double hung. Please revise the window schedule.
Got it Wendy, I'll send the revised window schedule to the architect today
Revised window schedule with the 3B casement sent to the architect
DOB inspector at footing F3 asked for more rebar chairs, we added them this morning
Storefront shop drawings will slip to next Wednesday, the glass supplier is late with the specs
Ok Sam, Wednesday latest please. We need them to release the frame order.
Elevator pit is flooded again after the rain, need a pump today
Eddie we're getting a pump from the rental yard
Pump is here and running, pit should be dry by tomorrow
Riser shop drawings sent to Kevin, check your email
FireSafe will start fire stopping on the 2nd floor Monday Oct 5
Storefront shop drawings sent, revision A, check your email
Storefront shop drawings approved with comments. Frame install is set for October 12.
lol finally
Con Ed inspection passed for the temp power
Slab on grade pour moved to next Thursday, waiting on the vapor barrier delivery
Structural engineer wants the beam pocket at grid C moved 6 inches east
Dumpster swap is set for Tuesday 10/6
